title: Terminal Next Steps
subtitle: Power Grid dashboard guidance
summary: The Power Grid Terminal tab summarizes the next commissioning action from loaded grid telemetry.
body: If no grid is synced, build a generator, battery, and cable run. If a network is stressed, stabilize supply or transfer first. If no high-voltage route exists, route High Voltage Cable into a Factory Substation. If reserve is thin, add a Field Battery Bank before scaling machines.
